title: Catalog setup lists you can change
problem: Catalog setup lists were fixed; Add only showed a message and products never used them.
now: Product fields, units, tax rates and size charts can be added, changed and deleted, and the product form offers them.
steps: Open Catalog setup, Units tab, add Carton (ctn)
Open Add product › Inventory, identifiers & units › Manage and pick Carton
Add a required field for Phones and save a phone without it
Delete Carton while a product uses it: it is refused
